notes.subject: long ia bilong pen
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'from the mouth of the strait/distress' — tok piksa; mi tanim olsem 'long ia bilong pen'.

notes.subject: דשן
notes.rationale: deshen: gris bilong ofa (ashes of fat) o 'fatness/abundance'; KJV 'fatness', BSB 'richness'.

notes.subject: ונחת
notes.gloss_of_alternative: na trabel i kamap long yu
notes.rationale: nachat: 'restful setting of thy table' (KJV) o 'punishment/imposition' (unfavorable) — dupela mining; mi holim pasin bilong kaikai.

translation: Na moa yet, Em i pulim yu kamaut long ia bilong pen, i go long wampela graun — i no gat tait ples long aninit bilong en; na kaikai long tebol bilong yu i pulpela tru wantaim gris bilong ol ofa.
